intro: Grok Imagine Image is xAI's image-generation and image-editing model. Useful prompts make composition, subject identity, lighting, typography, surface treatment, and edit boundaries explicit, while keeping the requested transformation easy to evaluate against the source image.
capabilities: Text-to-image composition with explicit framing and lighting
Image transformation while preserving pose, identity, or background
Product photography with controllable materials and camera language
Stylized rendering that separates structure from surface treatment
